invariants.rationale: Average size in bytes should never be negative; method returns a long estimate based on file sizes and thresholds.
Unless a recent commit provides a greater average, the method returns at least the default configured size estimate.
Average bytes per record should not exceed the small file threshold.
Multiplicative threshold used to compute fileSizeThreshold, so would not make sense to be negative or zero.
If there are no commits, the method returns the default size estimate from the configuration.
